body.name: Fixed-selection graphical compatibility fiber and mark set
body.construction:
For \(g\in\mathfrak G_{D,K}^{\mathrm{Dai,gr}}\) and a full signature \(\mathcal O\), define the purely structural fixed-selection fiber
\[
 \mathcal C_A^{\mathrm{gr}}(\mathcal O,g)
 :=\left\{\widetilde g\in\mathfrak G_{D,K}^{\mathrm{Dai,gr}}:
 A_{\mathrm{gr}}(\widetilde g)=A_{\mathrm{gr}}(g),\quad
 \mathcal O_{\mathrm{gr}}(\widetilde g)=\mathcal O\right\}.
\]
For a reported observed endpoint \(e\in\mathcal E(\mathcal O)\), define its graphically attained mark set by
\[
 \mathcal M_A^{\mathrm{gr}}(e;\mathcal O,g)
 :=\left\{\mu^{\mathrm{gr}}_{\widetilde g}(e):
 \widetilde g\in\mathcal C_A^{\mathrm{gr}}(\mathcal O,g)\right\}.
\]
Membership requires the Dai directed-acyclic, causal-sufficiency, childless-selection, observed-selection-parent, common-pre-intervention-selection, and direct-target conditions through \(\mathfrak G_{D,K}^{\mathrm{Dai,gr}}\), equality of the ancestral selected set, and equality of every skeleton and unshielded collider on each full domain \(U_j\).  It does not assert the existence of kernels that make \(\widetilde g\) faithful.
